title: The Snowy Cabin
answer: B, the skier. Snow fell until midnight. If she'd walked back at six, her prints would have been snowed over. Sharp, clear prints mean she walked after midnight.

beats.line: Ms. Frost was found dead in her mountain cabin. Three friends were staying nearby. One of them is lying.
That night, heavy snow fell until midnight.
The guide says he never left the lodge.
The skier says she walked back to the lodge at six.
The friend says she was asleep all night.
Clue one: the guide's boots, completely dry, by the lodge fire.

visual.label: Guide's boots: dry, by the fire

beats.line: Clue two: the friend's alarm, set for seven.
Clue three: a trail of the skier's boot prints from the cabin. Sharp and clear.
Only one alibi doesn't add up. Who's lying? A, B, or C?
Comment your answer. The solution is in the pinned comment.
